label: Review of the resident parking permit request

fields.name: decisionAgent
fields.label: Decision
fields.helpText: DEMANDER_INFOS puts the case on hold and sends the applicant a link to complete the request; the 30-day deadline restarts on their reply.

fields.name: motivation
fields.label: Reasons
fields.helpText: AUTORISER / REFUSER: reasons copied as is into the decision document. DEMANDER_INFOS: list of the expected information or documents (kept on the case; to be sent to the applicant, see the flow note).

label: Complete your resident parking permit request
_usage: variant with portal (external task filled in by the applicant)

fields.name: reponseComplement
fields.label: Additional information
fields.helpText: Answer the case officer's request. Supporting documents (registration certificate, proof of address…) are uploaded with the add-document button on this page.

label: Additional information received from the applicant
_usage: variant without portal (entered by the officer)

fields.name: reponseComplement
fields.label: Additional information received
fields.helpText: Summary of the applicant's reply, copied into the decision document. Add the documents received to the case items.

fields.name: dateReceptionComplement
fields.label: Date received
fields.helpText: The 30-day review deadline restarts when this task is completed.
